falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern match would be invalidated because that bottom formation held above 4,800 throughout its consolidation; a break below would signal a lower low structure, not a bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The BLOWOFF SCORE of 39 suggests elevated but contained fear; sustained VIX above 35 would indicate panic escalation inconsistent with a bottoming pattern and more consistent with crash continuation

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield curve uninverts (10Y yield exceeds 2Y yield by more than 10 basis points) and holds for 3+ days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The current pattern match assumes recessionary/stress bottom conditions; a sustained curve uninversion would signal policy success/economic normalization, invalidating the 'bottom' analog which requires persistent inversion

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
